examples.en: They are checking tickets at the theater entrance.

examples.ko: 검표가 끝나야 안으로 들어갈 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can go in only after the ticket check is done.

examples.ko: 검표원이 표를 확인하고 자리를 안내해 줬어요.
examples.en: The ticket checker looked at my ticket and showed me to my seat.

examples.ko: 기차에서 검표 때 표를 보여 주세요.
examples.en: Please show your ticket when tickets are checked on the train.

examples.ko: 검표는 입장 전에 하니까 미리 표를 꺼내 두세요.
examples.en: Tickets are checked before entry, so take yours out ahead of time.

examples.ko: 검표에 시간이 걸려서 공연이 조금 늦게 시작했어요.
examples.en: The ticket check took time, so the show started a little late.

explain: 극장, 공연장, 기차 같은 곳에서 표를 확인하는 일이에요. 평소 대화에서는 '표 확인'이라고 풀어서 말하는 경우도 많고, 일하는 사람은 '검표원'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: The ticket checker checks tickets at the entrance.
phrases.nuance_ko: 검표하는 일을 하는 사람을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the person who checks tickets.

phrases.en: They check tickets on the train.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가장 기본적인 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the most basic pairing.

phrases.example: 입장 전에 표 확인을 해 주세요.
phrases.en: Please have your ticket checked before entering.
phrases.nuance_ko: '검표'를 쉬운 말로 풀어 쓴 표현이라 대화에서 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is an easier way of saying 검표 and is more common in conversation.

explain_en: It is the act of checking tickets at places like theaters, concert halls and trains. In everyday talk people often just say '표 확인', and the person who does it is a '검표원'.

en: visit to a doctor's office; visit to a hospital

examples.ko: 내원 전에 먼저 전화로 예약해 주세요.
examples.en: Please make an appointment by phone before you visit the hospital.

examples.ko: 내원 시 신분증과 건강보험증을 꼭 가져오세요.
examples.en: When you visit, be sure to bring your ID and health insurance card.
Please briefly write the reason for your visit.

examples.ko: 이번 달 내원 횟수가 많아서 진료비가 늘었어요.
examples.en: I visited the hospital many times this month, so my medical costs went up.

examples.ko: 지난달 내원 기록을 보니 두 번 오셨네요.
examples.en: Looking at last month's visit records, you came twice.

examples.ko: 내원 환자가 갑자기 늘어서 대기 시간이 길어요.
examples.en: The number of visiting patients suddenly rose, so the wait is long.

explain: 병원 접수 안내나 진료 기록에서 자주 보는 말이에요. 일상에서는 '병원에 가다/오다'라고 하고, 환자가 자기 이야기를 할 때는 '병원에 갔어요'가 자연스러워요. 보통 '내원 시', '내원 환자', '내원 기록'처럼 다른 명사 앞에 붙여 써요.

phrases.example: 내원 시 접수처에서 이름을 말해 주세요.
phrases.en: When you visit the hospital, please give your name at the reception desk.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병원 안내문에서 '병원에 올 때'라는 뜻으로 가장 많이 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common way hospital notices say 'when you come to the hospital'.

phrases.en: There are more patients visiting the hospital today than usual.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병원에 찾아온 환자를 가리킬 때 써요. 병원 직원이 주로 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to patients who come to a hospital; mostly used by hospital staff.

phrases.en: I'll check your previous visit records.
phrases.nuance_ko: 병원에 온 날짜와 진료 내용을 적은 기록을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the record of when someone visited and what was treated.

explain_en: You often see this word in hospital reception notices and medical records. In daily life people say '병원에 가다/오다', and a patient talking about themselves would naturally say '병원에 갔어요'. It is usually attached before another noun, as in '내원 시', '내원 환자' or '내원 기록'.

examples.en: This milk must be kept refrigerated.

examples.ko: 냉장 식품은 집에 오면 바로 넣으세요.
examples.en: Put refrigerated food away as soon as you get home.
Many shops deliver raw fish refrigerated.
Refrigeration and freezing use different storage temperatures.

examples.ko: 여름에는 냉장 트럭이 음식을 나르는 모습이 자주 보여요.
examples.en: In summer you often see refrigerated trucks carrying food.
The package said 'keep refrigerated'.

explain: '냉장 보관'이라고 포장지에 가장 많이 나와요. 반대는 얼리는 '냉동'이고, 상온에 두는 건 '실온'이라고 해요. 집에서 쓰는 기계 이름은 '냉장고'예요.

phrases.en: After opening, please keep it refrigerated.
phrases.nuance_ko: 포장지와 안내문에 가장 흔하게 나오는, 차갑게 두라는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common wording on packaging, meaning keep it cold.

phrases.en: Please put the milk in the refrigerator compartment.
phrases.nuance_ko: 냉동실과 구별해서 냉장고에서 얼리지 않는 칸을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The non-freezing compartment of a fridge, as opposed to the freezer.

phrases.example: 이 음식은 냉장 상태에서 사흘 동안 먹을 수 있어요.
phrases.en: This food can be eaten for three days when kept refrigerated.
phrases.nuance_ko: 음식이 차갑게 보관된 상태를 설명할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes food that is being kept cold.

explain_en: You mostly see it on packaging as 냉장 보관. The opposite is 냉동 (frozen), and keeping at room temperature is 실온. The appliance itself is 냉장고.

examples.ko: 장례식장 입구에서 조의금을 내고 방명록에 이름을 썼어요.
examples.en: At the funeral hall entrance, I gave my condolence money and wrote my name in the guest book.
There is a guestbook at the café entrance.

examples.ko: 여행 간 곳마다 방명록에 한마디씩 남겼어요.
examples.en: At every place I visited on my trip, I left a few words in the guestbook.

examples.ko: 박물관 방명록을 읽다 보니 외국인 방문객이 많았어요.
examples.en: Reading the museum guestbook, I saw there were many foreign visitors.
In the past, every personal website had a guestbook.
Where do I sign the guestbook?

explain: 결혼식, 장례식, 전시장 같은 곳에서 이름과 짧은 글을 남기는 책을 말해요. '방명록을 쓰다·남기다'라고 하고, 예전 인터넷 홈페이지의 방명록 게시판에도 썼어요.

phrases.en: I wrote in the guestbook at the exhibition.
phrases.nuance_ko: 방명록에 이름이나 짧은 글을 적는 일을 가장 기본으로 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most basic way to say you wrote your name or a short message in the book.

phrases.en: Please write your name in the guestbook at the entrance.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이름만 남긴다는 점을 분명히 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Makes clear that you are only leaving your name.
phrases.en_equiv: to write one's name in the guestbook

phrases.en: I left a message in the guestbook on the travel spot's website.
phrases.nuance_ko: 짧은 인사나 느낌을 남길 때 쓰고, 인터넷 방명록에도 어울려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for leaving a short greeting or comment, and fits online guestbooks too.
phrases.en_equiv: to leave a message in the guestbook

explain_en: It is the book where you leave your name and a short note at weddings, funerals and exhibitions. You say '방명록을 쓰다' or '방명록을 남기다', and the word was also used for the guestbook boards on old websites.

en: to impersonate; to feign; to pretend

examples.ko: 누가 우리 회사 직원을 사칭해서 전화했어요.
examples.en: Someone called, pretending to be an employee of our company.

examples.ko: 그 사람은 의사를 사칭하고 돈을 받았어요.
examples.en: That person posed as a doctor and took money.
There are many accounts impersonating a famous singer.
I received a text pretending to be from a delivery company.
You must not pose as a police officer.
A person who tried to pose as a big-company employee was caught.

explain: 'N을/를 사칭하다'로 쓰고, 남의 신분이나 기관 이름을 거짓으로 내세워 속일 때 써요. 장난으로 흉내 내는 건 '따라 하다', '흉내 내다'를 쓰고, 사칭하다는 사기나 범죄 이야기에 어울려요. 주로 '사칭한 문자', '사칭하는 계정'처럼 꾸며 주는 말로 나와요.

phrases.en: I received a text impersonating the police.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-ㄴ'을 붙여 앞의 명사를 꾸미는 형태로 뉴스에서 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: A past modifier form for the noun that follows; often seen in the news.

phrases.en: They impersonated a bank employee and demanded money.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이유나 방법으로 사칭을 이어서 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to connect impersonation as a method or reason with what follows.

phrases.en: Don't impersonate someone else's name.
phrases.nuance_ko: 하지 말라고 경고하거나 부탁하는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A warning or request not to do it.

explain_en: It is used as 'N을/를 사칭하다' when falsely claiming someone's identity or an organization's name to deceive. For playful imitation, use '따라 하다' or '흉내 내다'; 사칭하다 fits fraud and crime stories. It often appears as a modifier, as in '사칭한 문자' and '사칭하는 계정'.

examples.en: I replaced the water purifier's filter with a new one.

examples.ko: 수족관 여과기가 고장 나서 물이 흐려졌어요.
examples.en: The aquarium filter broke, so the water became cloudy.

examples.ko: 커피 여과기에 종이를 깔고 가루를 넣어요.
examples.en: I put paper in the coffee filter and add the grounds.

examples.ko: 여과기를 한 달에 한 번 씻어 주세요.
examples.en: Please wash the filter once a month.

examples.ko: 이 여과기는 작은 먼지도 잘 걸러 줘요.
examples.en: This filter catches even small particles of dust.
Food got stuck in the sink strainer.

explain: 물이나 공기, 커피 속의 찌꺼기를 걸러 내는 기구예요. 말할 때는 '필터'라고도 해요.

phrases.example: 한 달에 한 번 여과기를 교체해요.
phrases.en: I replace the filter once a month.
phrases.nuance_ko: 기구를 새것으로 바꿀 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing for swapping in a new filter.

phrases.en: The water ran slowly, so I cleaned the filter.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여과기에 쌓인 찌꺼기를 닦아 낼 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for cleaning out debris built up in the filter.

phrases.en: We ran out of coffee filters.
phrases.nuance_ko: 말할 때는 '여과기'보다 '필터'를 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: In speech, '필터' is used more often than '여과기'.

explain_en: It is a device that strains out residue from water, air or coffee. In speech people also call it a '필터'.

examples.en: I'll pray that Grandmother recovers fully soon.
The doctor said I've fully recovered.

examples.ko: 수술 후 한 달이 지나야 완쾌할 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can only recover fully after a month has passed since the surgery.
To get over your cold completely, you need to rest well.
I wrote "Get well soon" on the hospital visit card.

examples.ko: 다친 다리가 완쾌해서 다시 운동을 시작했어요.
examples.en: My injured leg healed completely, so I started exercising again.

explain: '낫다'보다 격식 있는 말이고, 병문안 인사 '빨리 완쾌하세요'로 자주 들어요. 윗사람에게는 '완쾌하시길 바랍니다'처럼 높여서 말해요. 비슷한 말로 '쾌유'가 있어서 '쾌유를 빌어요'라고도 해요.

phrases.en: Teacher, please get well soon.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아픈 사람에게 하는 병문안 인사말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A greeting for visiting or wishing well to someone who is sick.

phrases.en: I hope my friend recovers completely as soon as possible.
phrases.nuance_ko: 그 사람이 낫기를 바라는 마음을 전할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to express hope that someone will get better.

phrases.en: I wish you a speedy recovery.
phrases.nuance_ko: '완쾌하다'와 비슷한 뜻이지만 인사나 편지에서 더 정중하게 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Close in meaning, but more polite and typical of greetings and letters.
phrases.en_equiv: I wish you a speedy recovery

explain_en: It is more formal than '낫다', and you often hear it in the get-well greeting '빨리 완쾌하세요'. To elders you raise it, as in '완쾌하시길 바랍니다'. A similar word is '쾌유', as in '쾌유를 빌어요'.

en: measure; action taken (to deal with something)

examples.en: Prices stabilized a little thanks to the government's measures.

examples.ko: 문제가 생기자 회사는 곧바로 조처를 취했어요.
examples.en: As soon as the problem arose, the company took action.

examples.ko: 늦은 조처 때문에 피해가 더 커졌어요.
examples.en: The damage grew because the action came late.
Parents protested against the school's measure.
Whatever measure it is, it must be taken quickly.
This measure will apply from next month.

explain: '조치'와 같은 뜻으로 쓰는 말이에요. '조처를 취하다/내리다'처럼 말하고, 개인의 일보다는 정부, 회사, 학교가 문제에 대응하는 일에 많이 써요.

phrases.en: The school took quick action.
phrases.nuance_ko: '조처'와 같은 뜻이고, 요즘은 '조치'를 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as 조처, though 조치 is more common these days.

phrases.example: 학교는 문제를 일으킨 학생에게 조처를 취했어요.
phrases.en: The school took action against the student who caused the problem.
phrases.nuance_ko: '조처'와 가장 자주 함께 쓰는 말로, 문제에 대응하는 일을 한다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common verb pairing for 조처, meaning to take action in response to a problem.

phrases.en: If there's a problem, I'll take appropriate action.
phrases.nuance_ko: 상황에 알맞은 대응을 말할 때 써요. 회사나 기관의 안내문에서 자주 보여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to a response that fits the situation; often seen in notices from companies or institutions.

explain_en: It has the same meaning as '조치'. It is used in phrases like '조처를 취하다/내리다' and mostly refers to a government, company or school responding to a problem rather than personal matters.

examples.en: Residents submitted a petition to city hall.
Could you sign the petition?

examples.ko: 탄원서에는 이름과 사정이 자세히 적혀 있었어요.
examples.en: The petition had names and circumstances written in detail.
The neighbors gathered and wrote the petition together.
Thanks to the petition, the problem was solved quickly.
Where should I submit the petition?

explain: 억울한 사정을 알리고 도움이나 선처를 바라는 글이라서, 단순히 신청하는 '신청서'와 달리 호소하는 내용이 중심이에요. '탄원서를 내다/쓰다/제출하다/서명하다'처럼 써요.

phrases.en: The lawyer submitted a petition to the court.
phrases.nuance_ko: 공식적으로 글을 내는 상황에서 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when formally handing in a document.

phrases.en: The neighbors wrote a petition together.
phrases.nuance_ko: 억울한 사정을 글로 적을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when writing out an unfair situation in a letter.

phrases.en: Many people signed the petition.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여러 사람이 뜻을 함께할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when many people join in support.

explain_en: It is a written appeal that explains an unfair situation and asks for help or leniency, so unlike a plain application form ('신청서'), its core is the appeal. It is used as '탄원서를 내다/쓰다/제출하다/서명하다'.
